between_event_structure: One eta per event occurrence and IMT; eta is repeated exactly across all 470 sites.

cross_imt_structure.application: The same rho is applied separately to between-event and within-event normalized residual pairs. This follows the paper's use of a common correlation model for inter-event, intra-event, and total residuals.
cross_imt_structure.model: Baker and Jayaram (2008) inter-period residual correlation

future_spatial_extension: Retain z_site_latent_1 and z_site_latent_2. A future spatial case can apply a source/period-specific spatial transform to each latent site vector before the cross-IMT combination, preserving the same base random numbers and event catalog.
occurrence_identity: control_case_id + rupture_id + realization_index; Cell 17 event_id is retained only as rupture-template provenance and is not reused as an event-occurrence identifier.
seed_derivation: First 128 bits of SHA-256 over pipe-delimited identifiers; separate streams for event-level and site-level latent standard normals.
site_order_requirement: The site-level generator emits values in validated site_ordinal order 0..469. The site-order CSV hash freezes this mapping.
within_event_spatial_structure: Independent latent standard normals across sites. No spatial correlation is applied in the Phase 1 baseline.
